observations: A black game console with the characteristic two-tier 'slim' profile, wrapped in protective plastic film.
One black DualShock 4 controller is resting on the console.
A UK-style (Type G) power cable is present.
All three photos are nearly identical, showing the same top-down view.
A watermark 'KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES AND' is visible across the center of the images.
No images show the console powered on, the rear ports, or the manufacturer's identification labels.

claims.evidence: The physical design in photos 0-2 matches the Sony PlayStation 4 Slim.
No photo of the storage settings or the console's underside label is provided.
This refers to the system firmware version; no photo of the system information screen is shown.
The console is not shown connected to a screen or powered on.
There is no visual evidence of a jailbreak or installed games on the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may not function or have a failed HDMI output.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting and displaying the home menu on a TV.

risks.risk: The firmware may be updated beyond the 'low version' required for hacking.
risks.proof: Photo of Settings > System > System Information showing the software version.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or button failure.
risks.proof: A video demonstrating the controller working in-game or in a test menu.

risks.risk: The internal storage may be smaller than 500GB or the drive may be failing.
risks.proof: Photo of the Settings > Storage menu.

proof_requests: Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the firmware version.
Photo of the 'Storage' screen showing the hard drive capacity.
Video of the console running a game to confirm it works and the fan is not excessively loud.
Photo of the model label on the console to confirm the exact model number.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a PS4 Slim. Although the 'hacked' status and working condition are unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working, standard firmware) until the seller provides proof.
